description: The skill suggests `mvn clean -DbuildDirectory=out` to clean a specific directory, but `buildDirectory` is not a standard Maven Clean Plugin system property/CLI option. This is misleading guidance for changing the clean target directory (which is normally configured via plugin `<configuration><directory>...`).

The skill claims `mvn install -amd` will "Skip unchanged modules", but `-amd` means "also make dependents" (typically used with `-pl`) and does not implement incremental/changed-module skipping. This is incorrect and can mislead build triage strategy in multi-module projects.

The Jenkins example uses `mvn -B verify -DskipUnitTests` to skip unit tests. `skipUnitTests` is not a standard Surefire/Failsafe property (common ones are `-DskipTests`, `-Dmaven.test.skip=true`, or `-DskipITs` for failsafe). Presenting it as a generic Maven flag is misleading.
